title: HInter: Exposing Hidden Intersectional Bias in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Metamorphic testing using mutations to substitute race-related terms based on a bias dictionary extracted from the SBIC corpus, validated via dependency parsing, and evaluated by observing discrepancies in model outputs.

Metamorphic testing using mutations to substitute gender-related terms based on a bias dictionary extracted from the SBIC corpus, validated via dependency parsing, and evaluated by observing discrepancies in model outputs.

Metamorphic testing using mutations to substitute terms related to body attributes based on a bias dictionary, validated via dependency parsing, and evaluated by checking if the LLM prediction changes.

Simultaneously mutating combinations of two sensitive attributes (e.g., race X gender, body X race) using higher-order mutations to expose hidden biases that are not triggered during atomic (single-attribute) bias testing.
